notes: Imputation (hot-deck and sequential regression) for missing race and income, the exclusion of reports of 12 months or more, and the sensitivity re-analysis are data handling, not procedures; the sensitivity result is therefore not recorded. The 23-state comparison with the national 15.6% is a secondary fixed-referent comparison, and the NHANES 2009–2014 estimate is external, so neither sets the framework.
